Edit the FIRST image, a padded 3 column by 2 row atlas of 6 actual articulated poses. Deliver the same exact grid and same ordered poses as one transparent RGBA animation source asset. This is sentinelColossus, a heavy walking non-living petricite construct for an original Heroes of Might and Magic III additional town. Finish these coarse volumetric guides as richly textured painted/prerendered game sprites, using the SECOND image for its actual identity, armor geometry, carved face, materials and Demacian crest. THIRD image gives original Heroes III native rendering and relative scale only; do not copy any original troop. FOURTH image is the official winged blade crest shape, which must remain on the construct's chest.
Action: six successive slow walking phases, alternating planted legs and lifted return, no sliding or running. Every complete figure must face right in the same fixed three-quarter battle camera as the source. Preserve head, torso and foot proportions and all actual limb directions. Keep the exact fixed camera, feet baseline and root location from cell to cell. Retain generous transparent gutters, with the ENTIRE figure, feet, fists and armor inside its own cell. No missing or duplicated poses; no extra figures or detached fragments. Quiet poses remain quiet; the fourth combat pose makes actual contact. Arms and fists are stone parts attached to actual shoulders/elbows, not floating blocks.
Base Sentinel Colossus: plain weathered pale petricite plates, simple unadorned shoulders and helmet, dark eye slots, blue chest crest and short blue tabard. Modest base equipment; no elite gold edging or glowing eyes.
Match the ORIGINAL Heroes III aesthetic: compact readable silhouettes, stony painted surface variation, matte rough ivory stone with deep joints, restrained blue cloth and gold where specified, upper-left light, grounded mass and shadows on the BODY. Not glossy modern3D, anime, splash art, vector art, Lego, toy blocks or a pixel filter. The coarse rig is a pose guide; refine chamfered stone anatomy and hands to the actual identity model without changing the poses. No floor, platform, backdrop, labels, lettering, chart lines, ground shadows, scenery or effects. Background and gutters must be genuinely transparent, including inside arm/leg gaps. Do not add flight, a weapon, halo, resurrection, extra limbs or motion blur.
